newsitem.title: JAPAN: JNR Corp says land sold for 372.3 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: JNR Corp says land sold for 372.3 bln yen.

text.p: Three tracts of prime land in central Tokyo auctioned by JNR Settlement Corp on Monday were sold for a total of 372.3 billion yen, JNR Settlement Corp said on Monday.

JNR said the successful bidders were a group led by Dentsu Inc; a group led by Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd, including Matsushita Electric Works and Alderney Investment Pte Ltd, and a group led by Nippon Television Network Corp.
It said there were 11 bidders for the three lots.
JNR said in statement it was pleased with the results.
"We hope the disposal of land will have good effects on real estate investment and economic activity," it said.
JNR Settlement Corp was set up in 1987 to sell off many of the assets owned by the now-defunct Japan National Railways when it was split up into seven regional companies.
JNR said it plans to sell the remaining tracts of land in the next fiscal year starting on April 1.
According to plans by successful bidders, the land that has been sold will be used for constructing hotels and buildings for commercial use, JNR said.
A total of 52,580 square metres of land was sold in the auction.
